analysis.analysis: Requirement R-175: Multiple distinct behaviors describing the existence of both Classic and Modern themes under themes preferences. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted as no explicit conditions, parameters, or failure paths are mentioned. Atomic behavior 1: Trigger: Navigate to themes preferences. Expected outcome: Classic theme exists. Atomic behavior 2: Trigger: Navigate to themes preferences. Expected outcome: Modern theme exists. Requirement R-176: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger: Select Classic theme. Expected outcome: Classic theme is displayed as in the given image. Requirement R-177: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger: Select Modern theme. Expected outcome: Modern theme is displayed as in the given image. Requirement R-178: Simple declaration. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger: Open View menu. Expected outcome: Theme Preferences item is available under View menu. Requirement R-179: Simple declaration. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger: Open View menu. Expected outcome: Get New Themes item is available under View menu. Requirement R-180: Simple declaration. Only a Normal test scenario is warranted.
